why: What an indicative call market would clear at now, which robots quote against during a call. Without seq a client cannot tell a stale value from a new one, since two pushes can arrive out of order; without at in UTC a robot timing its quotes against the next call is off by its own zone.

source.constructed: fm-server's CallIndicative record (4.17.0) as GET /marketplaces/{id}/markets/{marketId}/indicative and the CALL-INDICATIVE frame both send it: a crossed book, at zone-less in UTC with milliseconds, as the server writes it.
